static_traits.name: Lindsay
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with colleagues affected, tending to self-isolate at Work; having a few friends to talk to, but not yet discussing related feelings with them.
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; no psychotherapy history; No major physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, neutral tone; able to specifically describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts; tending to negate positive information when comparing with others; willing to try change but with hesitation.

basic_info.main_problem: I feel the drone manufacturing Work I do is not important, not unique, thus feeling devalued and lacking meaning.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling now because this feeling of being devalued is affecting my work performance and overall well-being.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of recognition
My Work is not important/not unique

special_situations.event: A colleague's drone project Gaining recognition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are recognized and I am not, it means my Work is not important and I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to shift attention to one's own skills and achievements to prove value
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My Work is not important; anyone could do it.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform distinctively in meetings, it proves I am not good enough and not worthy of being valued
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance from coworkers at Work, reducing participation to lower Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; everyone will think I am mediocre.

special_situations.event: Seeing others succeed while feeling stuck oneself
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others keep being recognized and I am not, it means I will not be seen and valued in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing with others to assess self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be recognized or valued like my colleagues.

special_situations.event: The team's informal appreciation of my contributions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it is not public, significant recognition, positive feedback does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or weakening positive feedback, continuing to focus on one's own shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This praise is not important; I am still not good enough.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen, to have unique and valuable work and self
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored and devalued, worrying about being proven 'ordinary and unimportant'
defense_goal: Reducing the hurt of being compared and judged through self-alienation and negating positive feedback

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough worker of mediocre value

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor prompts attention to positive evidence or emphasizes their unique skills and value
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing others' success as negation of oneself; understanding the counselor's affirmation as inconsistent with reality, further Reinforcing the 'I am not good enough' self-schema
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing one's own 'not good enough' in a self-blaming tone, weakening or negating positive feedback; when asked about successful experiences, responding briefly and quickly turning back to one's own shortcomings.

manifestations: Believing one's Work is not unique, not important
After a colleague is recognized, persistently feels devalued and purposeless
More noticeably experiencing a sense of Meaninglessness during team meetings and presentations
outcomes: Decreased work motivation and lower satisfaction
Increased anxiety, daily routines and self-care disrupted

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial and minimizing strengths in narration
Overly cautious about expressing self-worth, prioritizing attention on others' success
Chooses self-isolation in the workplace to avoid being evaluated

positive_force: Has the professional ability to quickly troubleshoot complex problems (colleagues once appreciated their contributions)
Able to identify and describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts
Willing to try alternative perspectives and take small steps (such as reminding oneself of one's contributions before meetings)
Has a few friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Persistent comparing and despairing thinking, defining self-worth through outside recognition
Negating positive thinking and mental filtering, minimizing positive feedback
Self-isolates at work, reducing contact with colleagues
Low sense of meaning at Work leading to Decreased motivation and satisfaction, accompanied by Increased anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety, Self-deprecation in team meetings/project presentations, and avoiding/distancing from colleagues
antecedent: Situations where colleagues get praised or succeed
Moments of comparing her own work with others
target_behavior.core_reason: Tightly binding self-worth to outside recognition; habitual comparison leading to the cognition that 'my Work is not important/not unique', and mentally filtering and negating positive feedback
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety and shame brought by evaluation and comparison, seeking short-term security and Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work motivation and satisfaction, impaired performance; Relationship estrangement with colleagues; daily routines and self-care disrupted
